# Retrospective Lite Workflow

## Trigger

Use after a task when there may be reusable learning, but the user has not explicitly requested writing to Memory OS.

## Memory OS Level

L1: suggest whether the task contains reusable experience without reading Memory OS by default.

Escalate to L3 only when the user explicitly asks to write, update, remember,沉淀,复盘, or generate a pending proposal.

## Steps

1. Identify whether the lesson is cross-project or repeatedly useful.
2. Reject one-off project details, sensitive information, private logs, secrets, and over-specific implementation facts.
3. If useful, ask whether to create a pending proposal.
4. Do not write to Memory OS without explicit user confirmation.

## Output

1. Reusable lesson candidate
2. Why it is or is not worth capturing
3. Suggested proposal target if confirmed
